name: How does a metal roof compare to asphalt shingles in terms of longevity?

mainEntity.name: How does a metal roof compare to asphalt shingles in terms of longevity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Metal roofs generally have a significantly longer lifespan than asphalt shingles. While asphalt shingles typically last 15-30 years, a properly installed metal roof can last 40-70 years or even longer. This extended durability means fewer replacements over the home's lifetime, offering a strong return on investment. The choice often comes down to balancing initial cost with long-term performance and reduced future maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Metal roofs typically last 40-70+ years, significantly longer than asphalt shingles (15-30 years). They offer greater durability and long-term value.
